bioCard.title: Web Developer, UI/UX & WordPress Developer
paragraphs: Hello! I'm Ilham Ramadan, a Software Engineering graduate experienced in building institutional websites and web applications using Laravel, PHP, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
I also handle UI/UX prototyping in Figma, WordPress development, and student mentoring in software projects.

items.title: Prestasi Prima Polytechnic
items.description: Modern campus website showcasing academic programs and institutional information.
items.overview: Developed a modern institutional website for Politeknik Prestasi Prima to present academic study programs, campus facilities, admission information, and digital news with a fast, responsive user interface.
features: Responsive study program & campus directory pages
Fast page performance and SEO-friendly structure
Clean, accessible UI built with Next.js & Tailwind CSS

items.title: Orens Absence System
items.description: Extracurricular attendance web app with QR Code scanning and GPS verification.
items.overview: A web-based extracurricular attendance platform (OrensPro) utilizing QR Code scanning and real-time GPS location verification to ensure accurate student attendance tracking and automated reporting.
features: Dynamic QR Code scanning & GPS radius verification
Real-time attendance session management
Filament admin dashboard with automated attendance reports

items.title: SMA Prestasi Prima Website
items.description: Official high school profile portal for academic news and announcements.
items.overview: Built and maintained the official school profile website for SMA Prestasi Prima to deliver academic announcements, student achievements, and institutional information.
features: Dynamic news, events & achievement gallery CMS
Mobile-responsive layout with Tailwind CSS
Structured MySQL database & content management panel

items.title: SMK Prestasi Prima Website
items.description: Vocational school website providing academic content and student digital services.
items.overview: Developed and maintained the official website for SMK Prestasi Prima, providing vocational program profiles, academic updates, and digital information services for students and parents.
features: Vocational department & facility showcase pages
Easy-to-use CMS dashboard for school administrators
Optimized query performance & server deployment

items.title: Alinea Library System
items.description: Online library CMS and REST API with QR code book borrowing and returns.
items.overview: Alinea is a mobile-connected online library management system. I developed the web CMS dashboard and RESTful API to power seamless book cataloging, borrowing, and return workflows via QR code scanning.
features: RESTful API integration for mobile library application
QR code-based book borrowing & return workflow
Web CMS for book inventory & member management

items.title: Otomod.com News Portal
items.description: 1st Place Bootcamp automotive news portal designed in Figma and built with Laravel.
items.overview: Otomod.com is an automotive news and review portal developed during the Software Development Bootcamp, where it won 1st Place. I led both the UI/UX design in Figma and full-stack Laravel implementation.
features: 1st Place Winner at Software Development Bootcamp 2024
Complete UI/UX wireframe & high-fidelity prototype in Figma
Full-stack article management, categories & reader interface
